Reticulocytes are immature red blood cells that contain cytoplasmic RNA which can be visualized with supravital staining.

Normally, mature red blood cells do not contain ribosomes or RNA and thus cannot synthesize proteins.
Reticulocytes normally compose about 1% of the red cells in the human body.
They develop in the bone marrow from precursor cells into mature red blood cells over a period of one week.
